content: आचरणम् .²1 Practising, doing, performing, following, observing; धर्म˚, मंगल˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²2 Conduct, behaviour; अधीतिबोधाचरणप्रचारणैः <ls>N. 1. 4</ls> example (<ab>opp.</ab> precept); अधर्म˚, दुर्˚ <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 Usage, practice. .²4 An institute; rite or rule of conduct. .²5 Approaching, arrival (as of the dawn); ये अस्या आचरणेषु दध्रिरे <ls>Rv. 1. 48. 3</ls>. .²6 A chariot, carriage; cart.
